items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Moe had to come to the door and get me. And they said, 'let the lady in. This is Miss Humes'.

ctx.x: Well tell me, when you came back from Louisville after you had gone home because your father had died, you said that you couldn't get into the place.

Yeah I couldn't. And I saw people lined up around both corners and I said, 'I wonder what's going on in here'. And so I went there and they didn't want to let me in and Moe had to come to the door and get me. And they said, 'let the lady in. This is Miss Humes'. And people started getting out of their way and they let me. And I said, well I ain't never seen nothing like that. And I never have seen nothing like that. And
